_README: Single source of truth for publications. The Publications page and the
'Recent work' block on the home page must both render from this file.
PMIDs are deliberately absent. Fetch them at build time from the NCBI
Sections render in the order listed under 'sections'.
'selected' drives the 'Selected publications' lists on the research pages.
Each key is a page path; each value is an ordered list of { doi } drawn
from 'publications' below (order is curated, not chronological). Add an
optional 'authors' to override a very long author list for that one entry.
The build renders them with the same DOI/PubMed links as the Publications
page. Do not hand-edit those lists in the HTML.
